item_01_hypothesis_and_mechanism.mechanism: Episodicity H_i(T) = sum over the trailing 2688 completed 15m bars of (q_b/Q)^2, q_b = close x volume (Herfindahl of dollar-volume shares, uniform baseline 1/2688). Resting liquidity has a temporal SHAPE; episodic names have thin standing depth between bursts, providers face bursty inventory/adverse-selection risk and quote wider effective spreads around bursts, and burst prints are information-dominated.
item_01_hypothesis_and_mechanism.economic_counterparty: the liquidity provider facing bursty flow and the positional holder whose risk-transfer needs do not coincide with the bursts
item_01_hypothesis_and_mechanism.why_edge_exists: fragility of episodic liquidity supply is priced by attention (bursts attract chasing flow) rather than by standing-liquidity quality, so smooth-turnover names are systematically underpriced relative to the liquidity service they provide a weekly holder; the shape is endogenous and persistent (Admati & Pfleiderer 1988) and crypto volume seasonality is strong and venue-specific (quarter-hour algorithmic cycles on Binance USDT-M perps; inverted-U intraday patterns)
item_01_hypothesis_and_mechanism.expected_sign: cross-sectionally LOW episodicity (smooth turnover) outperforms HIGH episodicity over the next week; long bottom tercile, short top tercile; signal contains no return term, no OI term, no funding term, no shock threshold, no price-impact term

item_02_falsifiable_prediction.prediction: after base costs the anchor earns positive BTC-beta-adjusted weekly excess in at least 2 of 3 frozen folds, the 56d neighbour supports the same sign, and the sign-inverted control does NOT pass the same gate
falsified_if_any_of: anchor beta-context excess not positive in >= 2/3 folds
sign-inverted control (long HIGH episodicity) also passes the incremental gate: ordering carries no directional liquidity information; anchor result is a tilt artifact
neighbour sign flips: shape not persistent, contradicting the mechanism persistence requirement
anchor passes base but fails stress: spread/slippage execution artifact, not liquidity structure
item_02_falsifiable_prediction.on_falsification: family rejected; control never promotable to a family; no post-hoc sign reinterpretation

primary_claims_carried: volume-time concentration is endogenous and persistent (L1)
crypto/perp volume seasonality is strong and venue-specific (L3)
concentration-style variables have prior art in cross-sectional work (L2, precedent only)
transfer_caveats: Admati-Pfleiderer is an equity session theory; crypto 24/7 + quarter-hour periodicity means the 28d shape mixes a periodic and a burst component by design; the 56d neighbour tests persistence of the mixture
Herfindahl over 2688 bins is downtime-sensitive; any missing 15m slot refuses the stamp fail-closed so gaps can never masquerade as thinness; refusal counts reported
dollar-volume proxies conflate taker/maker with intra-bar drift noise, identical across arms
prior equity concentration evidence is mixed and daily-aggregated; the a priori sign is declared from the provider/holder mechanism, not from precedent; an opposite sign falsifies per item 02
burstiness correlates with event attention and could be proxied by return-moment characteristics; the ancestry defense is that H uses no return moments whatsoever

item_05_universe_warmup_clock.universe: 19 tradable symbols = 20 staged REQUIRED_SYMBOLS minus BTCUSDT (benchmark only); per-symbol per-stamp eligibility fail-closed
item_05_universe_warmup_clock.decision_clock: weekly, every Monday 00:00:00Z (52 discretionary decisions/365d <= 60 floor)
item_05_universe_warmup_clock.execution_lag_declared: ONE lag: fills at the close of the first completed 15m bar strictly after T (Monday 00:15:00Z bar close), generic adapter costs on fills; stress adds +1 event delay
item_05_universe_warmup_clock.book_construction: long bottom tercile / short top tercile of H, 6 symbols per side, equal weight 1/12 per held symbol, gross 1.0, max |weight| = 1/12 <= 0.30 by construction, ties broken by symbol id ascending, middle tercile flat, force-flat at fold boundaries
item_05_universe_warmup_clock.folds: frozen V12 chronological F0/F1/F2 over blind-S0 window 2025-08-22..2026-08-21 with 1-day purge, imported unchanged

anchor.signal: Herfindahl H over trailing 2688 completed bars (28d)
anchor.book: long bottom tercile / short top tercile

neighbour.justification: Admati-Pfleiderer persistence implies a slow characteristic; 56d tests independence from one month of flow realization; in the frozen warmup table and the pre-declared sibling of the 28d anchor

causal_negative_control.signal: identical construction and book with the sign inverted (long HIGH episodicity / short LOW); factory-standard causal negative control isolating the declared sign from a generic long/short tilt

item_06_arms.preregistered_control_rule: control MUST NOT reproduce the anchor: if LIQEPIS-SIGN-INV passes the same incremental gate (BTC-beta-context excess positive in >= 2/3 folds), the episodic-liquidity mechanism is falsified, the anchor FAILS and the family is rejected; control never promotable regardless of its own result
item_06_arms.beta_funding_separation: identical universe, fills and native funding costs across arms; funding is cost only; BTC-beta-adjusted gate; anchor-minus-control difference is sign-direction liquidity information only

item_07_incremental_test.benchmark: BTCUSDT buy-and-hold over the same Monday stamps and fold boundaries
item_07_incremental_test.beta_context: beta from trailing 90d completed daily bars (frozen convention); weekly arm excess adjusted by BTC beta
item_07_incremental_test.gate: anchor BTC-beta-context excess positive in >= 2/3 folds (Stage-A, unrelaxed); raw excess vs buy-and-hold also positive in >= 2/3 folds for the family to advance; neighbour same sign; control must fail per item 06

item_08_costs_floors_concentration_dropo.costs_base: frozen generic adapter fee/slippage schedule on fills; native funding settlements on held legs counted once, cost only; base drag floor <= 8 pct/yr of gross
item_08_costs_floors_concentration_dropo.costs_stress: fee x1.5, +2 adverse ticks, +1 event delay; stressed drag floor <= 12 pct/yr of gross
item_08_costs_floors_concentration_dropo.feasibility_note: evaluated by A9-F from schedule artifacts only; no cost number computed in this proposal
item_08_costs_floors_concentration_dropo.drop_one_design: at the fold-stamp with the largest held |weight|, drop the single symbol attaining that maximum among held positions (non-vacuous by construction); renormalize to 5 per side at 1/10; family survives only if anchor fold-sign pattern and control-rule outcome are unchanged

item_09_failure_interpretation: anchor fails incremental gate in all folds: smooth-liquidity service not rewarded at weekly horizon or episodicity already priced by attention flows; family rejected, no parameter search
anchor positive but sign-inverted control also positive: no directional liquidity information in the ordering; anchor result is a tilt/cost artifact; family rejected; control never promotable
anchor positive, neighbour negative or sign-flipped: shape formation-window fragile, not the persistent characteristic the mechanism requires; family rejected
anchor passes base but fails stress: microstructure execution artifact; family rejected
one fold carries > 50 pct of positives: regime-driven burst quarter, not persistent; family rejected
largest symbol > 0.70 of positive PnL: single-name artifact; family rejected
high refusal rate from missing formation slots: BLOCKED_DATA verdict, not a mechanism rejection
